raw.cause: camera served every request normally (last reply at 3240.7 ms) and was then destroyed at 3274.8 ms. On display's next tick, MsgSend() on the dead camera connection returned -1. The camera-dies regression in run_display() treats that error as fatal ('camera failed ... giving up', return 1), so display exited 30 ms after camera instead of continuing to draw nav/logger frames.
raw.qnx_call: MsgSend in display (error return from dead camera treated as fatal)
raw.fix_summary: Do not exit when MsgSend to camera fails. Degrade to a 'no camera' frame and keep the nav/logger loop running. Better still, build with COCKPIT_FIXED=1 so the camera is read from its own camera_reader thread, which also protects display from a hung camera (a send timeout would not, because of _NTO_CHF_UNBLOCK on name_attach channels).

finding: camera died and took display down with it
